[[File:Brood_Totem.png|thumb|right|200px|The Brood Totem]]
The '''Brood Totem''' was a device constructed by the [[Imperial Science Bureau (Sith Empire)|Imperial Science Bureau]] in the years of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was developed with intended use against the [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The machine was intended to synchronise with the creatures and when deployed it served to attract them to a site. The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] intended to use the Totem on the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] territory in order to use the Killiks against this [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] family that was allied with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
